kultivator.titah_client.decree.2: Seven Stars of the Northern Dipper
kultivator.titah_client.film.penuh.tip: The whole film: the mark, the rise up the pillar of light, heaven's vista, then the ride down with the weapon (at most 12 s, every camera cut at most 4 s). Needs Cinematic camera: Full; Backspace skips, any movement key stops it, a hit snaps back.
kultivator.titah_client.film.singkat.tip: A short 2 s crane that looks up at the falling weapon.
kultivator.titah_client.film.mati.tip: No camera for this decree. The mark, the impact frames and the strike still play.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.title: Heaven's Decree
kultivator.titah_client.screen.k.tip: Scales the size of the decree: its marks, rings, sigils and craters. It never raises the damage a single foe takes; a larger decree only waits longer.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.d.tip: Share of the decree's authored damage, from 0 % (pure spectacle) to 100 %. Never above it.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.v.tip: How fast heaven answers: the build-up and the film follow it. The camera never moves faster than its limits.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.h.tip: Only while your own Mode Kehancuran is on: the decree really carves the land (no drops, undoable with Restore). Off: visual only.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.m.tip: The weapon stays planted in the crater as a real object. Sneak and use it to pull it out again.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.pick.tip: Put this decree on the seal: right-click with the seal casts it at your crosshair.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.reset.tip: Back to this decree's default size, damage and speed. The decree film is set in Settings › Kamera & Film.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.warning.t: Read the photosensitivity warning and choose whether full impact frames may flash.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.hint: Backspace: skip the film · Movement: stop the camera
kultivator.titah_client.screen.readout: Radius ≈ %s b · wounds ≤ %s b · ≤ %s blocks · wait %s · qi %s%%
kultivator.titah_client.screen.desc.0: A sword of heaven's decree falls point-first down a pillar of light; the land splits along your aim and the sword stays planted.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.desc.1: The iron pillar thrown into heaven returns in silence; the shock ring flattens the land into a molten crater and the pillar keeps standing.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.desc.2: The Dipper is drawn onto the land; seven stars fall in order, star crystals grow, and the lines ignite.
kultivator.titah_client.screen.desc.3: A square jade seal stamps the land; a light grid cuts it into cells that heaven carries off, leaving a stepped glowing pit.
